test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: How many physical regions are there in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**6**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **There are 6 physical regions** in India.
 
• The six physical regions of India are:
 
 
• The Northern Mountains
 
• The Northern Plains
 
• The Peninsular Plateau
 
• The Indian Desert
 
• The Coastal Plains
 
• The Islands
 
 
 
• Each of these regions has distinct geographical features and climate conditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Northern Mountains include the **Himalayas**, which are the highest mountain range in the world.
 
• The Northern Plains are formed by the **alluvial deposits of the Indus, Ganga, and Brahmaputra rivers**.
 
• The Peninsular Plateau is the oldest landmass and is rich in minerals.
 
• The Indian Desert, also known as the **Thar Desert**, is located in the state of Rajasthan.
 
• The Coastal Plains lie on either side of the Peninsular Plateau and have **fertile soil**.
 
• The Islands consist of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands in the Bay of Bengal and the Lakshadweep Islands in the Arabian Sea.
